description: Returns all SPL Token accounts by approved Delegate.

parameters.name: pubkey
parameters.description: The Pubkey of account delegate to query encoded as base-58 string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The JSON object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: mint
sub_parameters.description: The Pubkey of the specific token Mint to limit accounts to, as base-58 encoded string

sub_parameters.name: programId
sub_parameters.description: The Pubkey of the Token program ID that owns the accounts, as base-58 encoded string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The JSON object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: finalized
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block confirmed by the supermajority of the cluster as having reached maximum lockout, meaning the cluster has recognized this block as finalized

sub_parameters.name: confirmed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block that has been voted on by the supermajority of the cluster

sub_parameters.name: processed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query its most recent block. Note that the block may not be complete

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: (Default: binary) The encoding format for account data. It can be one of base58 (slow), base64, binary, base64+zstd or jsonParsed

sub_parameters.name: dataSlice
sub_parameters.description: The returned account data using the provided offset: 'usize' and length: 'usize' fields; only available for base58, base64, or base64+zstd encodings

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

result.description: An object with the following fields:

result.context.description: The information about the current state of the program

result.context.apiVersion.description: The version of the Solana RPC API to use

result.context.slot.description: An integer representing the slot for which to retrieve the fee calculator

result.value.description: A JSON object with the following fields:

result.value.account.description: An address on the Solana blockchain that is used to store assets

result.value.account.data.description: Token state data associated with the account. Format depends on encoding parameter:

result.value.account.data.program.description: The program that manages the token

result.value.account.data.parsed.description: An array of parsed instructions that were executed in the block's transactions

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.description: An array of information objects that provide additional details about the transactions in the block

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.to.description: The balance of the token in the token account
The raw total token supply without decimals, a string representation of a u64 integer
An integer value representing the number of decimal places used by the token
The total token supply using mint-prescribed decimals (DEPRECATED)
The total token supply as a string using mint-prescribed decimals

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.de.description: The public address of the delegate from which the account tokens are to be retrieved encoded as base-58 string
The configuration object with the following fields:
The raw total token supply without decimals, a string representation of a u64 integer
An integer value representing the number of decimal places used by the token
The total token supply using mint-prescribed decimals (DEPRECATED)
The total token supply as a string using mint-prescribed decimals

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.is.description: A boolean value indicating whether the token is a native token of the Solana blockchain

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.mi.description: Provides information about the creation of new tokens

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.ow.description: The base-58 encoded Pubkey of the program this account has been assigned to

result.value.account.data.parsed.info.st.description: The current state of the token account

result.value.account.data.parsed.type.description: The type of the block. It can be used to differentiate between regular blocks and special blocks such as snapshot or transaction confirmation blocks

result.value.account.data.space.description: The amount of storage space required to store the token account

result.value.pubkey.description: The public key associated with the token account
